title: Atomic insight tiles & adaptive token matrix for compact dashboards
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Goal: define a set of compact, reusable 'insight tiles' and an adaptive token matrix that map density, status, and cost/latency semantic states across the Redwood Console. These tiles will be the canonical primitives used in dashboards, rollout panels, and budget/cost views.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Figma library contains 3 size variants (compact, medium, expanded) for each tile. 2) Token matrix doc lists semantic tokens for color, elevation, spacing, and typography with clear mapping to density scales. 3) Accessible contrast and keyboard focus states validated for each variant. 4) Hand-off package with CSS variables, React props mapping, and example Storybook stories. 5) Sign-off from PM and Eng UX reviewer.
deliverables: Figma component library, token matrix spec (Confluence), responsive prototype (Figma interactive), accessibility checklist, code handoff notes and Storybook examples.
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs:
- Chose semantic tokens (eg. token-insight-bg/ token-insight-accent) over raw color tokens to reduce friction when applying rollout-state overlays.
- Opted for three discrete density breakpoints rather than fully fluid spacing to simplify engineering props and autoscaling behavior.
- Decided to use icon-only micro-actions in compact mode to avoid text truncation, with explicit hover labels for discoverability (tradeoff: slightly higher cognitive load in compact views).
- Deferred animated transitions for rollout state changes to a follow-up ticket to keep initial implementation lightweight for Dedicated/Private deployments.
accessibility_notes: All text variants meet WCAG AA for contrast at normal sizes; compact microcopy uses 12px which requires bold weight to meet contrast—documented in token matrix. Focus ring added to all interactive tiles; keyboard navigation pattern documented in Confluence. ARIA roles and live-region guidance included for status updates in rollout tiles.
implementation_notes: Engineering mapping: provide 'density' prop (compact|medium|expanded), 'state' prop (default|warning|error|muted|success|rolling-out), and 'variant' prop (metric|sparkline|badge|action). Tokens exported as CSS vars: --insight-bg, --insight-border, --insight-accent, --insight-elevation-1..3. Suggest Storybook knobs for density and state combos. Backend: ensure metrics endpoints can return 3 size-suitable payload shapes to avoid overfetch in compact mode.
